digest.component_or_area: GitHub Actions CI scheduling — CodeQL workflow
propositions: CodeQL workflow originally ran on every push to main plus a weekly cron; after push trigger was removed from main CI, the weekly cron became the primary scan of newly-landed code rather than a between-pushes backstop, leaving up to 7 days of exposure for newly-introduced SAST findings
The 6-hourly tick was specified as the replacement for push-on-main triggering, so CodeQL must join the 6-hourly cadence to restore coverage parity with its pre-push-removal posture

CodeQL moves to 6-hourly cron 35 */6 * * * staggered distinctly off-the-hour from sibling lanes (test.yml :41, optionality.yml :47, verify-identity.yml :53) with no push trigger and workflow_dispatch retained
The stale header comment asserting a 28x cost increase and deliberate weekly-only cadence must be rewritten, as navapbc/rebar is public and CodeQL/Actions minutes are free for public repos
Test coverage in test_ci_main_push_policy.py must move CodeQL from _OWN_CADENCE into a new schedule-only 6-hourly cohort, retaining no-push and workflow_dispatch assertions
prompt-eval.yml (weekly) and terraform-drift.yml (daily) remain unchanged and out of scope
